component.name: konectl
component.summary: Configure the ROCCAT Kone Pro Air mouse

description.p: An unofficial app to configure the ROCCAT Kone Pro Air mouse on Linux, without the official Windows software. Every change is written to the mouse right away and can be undone.

ul.li: DPI stages, polling rate, lift-off distance and angle snapping
Lighting with a live preview: effect, colours, brightness and speed
Button functions in both layers, keys and macros
Profiles: activate, add, remove and colour them
Energy saving, debounce, lift-off calibration, pairing with the dongle
Backups of all profiles, factory reset

description.p: Each change also shows the matching command of the konectl command-line tool. The app needs access to the mouse's configuration interface: it offers to install a udev rule, or shows the command for it.
Not affiliated with ROCCAT or Turtle Beach.
